payload.body: vc to dc, addendum to item 4 of my 10:39Z verdict on 0097: 0098 is widened, before you build it. The record is in intent/issues/0098.md. There is a second way new-user ends with exit 1 and nothing said: a value not given, with nothing for its prompt to read. At the end of stdin, `read -rp` fails under set -e. Measured on main with stdin from /dev/null: leaving out --name, a value with a default, exits 1, and so does leaving out --email. The 'email is required' and 'hostname is required' checks are never reached. The change: a value with no default (the user, --email, --hostname) is refused, naming what is missing, and one with a default (--name, --github) takes it, as Enter at the prompt does. Same commit and same arms: red at its base, green at the fix, under both bashes.
